purpose: Finite inventory of the separately enumerated TA98 skull-as-a-whole chapter; does not add anatomical claims or modify the atlas.
scope: All 97 cached source rows A02.1.00.001-A02.1.00.097, without silent exclusions.
source_cache_signature: Number of units 97; page date 04.06.2022; IFAA TA98 electronic nomenclature.
classification_note: Proposed planning buckets only, not authoritative anatomy or final inclusion decisions. Views/groups do not necessarily require separate meshes; presence of a code does not prove geometry, and absence of a code does not prove absent geometry. Parentheses are preserved as source typography and do not automatically establish a variant. All rows still need explicit scope disposition.

category_definitions.view: A named viewing orientation; require a reproducible oriented view if included.
category_definitions.group: An aggregate or organizational concept; require explicit constituent coverage and navigation if included.
category_definitions.adult_anatomy: Provisional adult anatomical target; determine required point, boundary, surface, lumen, or composite geometry separately. This is not a claim that every target is present in every adult.
category_definitions.developmental: Provisional development-related scope; decide required age/specimen examples before assessing geometry.
category_definitions.requires_scope_review: Unresolved tissue/variant/specimen boundary; no anatomical presence or exclusion inferred.
